# Ezekiel 24 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 24:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Heap-on the-wood, kindle the-fire, consume the-flesh, and-pour-out the-broth, and-the-bones shall-be-charred. |
| LOGOS | Heap on the logs, kindle the fire, boil the meat well, mix in the spices, and let the bones be burned up. |
| PNEUMA | Pile on the wood! Light the fire! Cook the meat thoroughly! Mix in the spices! Let the bones char! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 24:12 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | With-toil she-has-wearied, and-her-great rust has-not-gone-out from-her; in-the-fire [goes] her-rust. |
| LOGOS | She has wearied herself with toil; its abundant corrosion does not go out of it. Into the fire with its corrosion! |
| PNEUMA | But it's useless — even fire can't clean this pot. The corrosion is too deep. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 24:15 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | Then the LORD said to me: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 24:20 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-said to-them, "The-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | Then I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | So I told them, "The LORD gave me this message: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 24:22 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-you-shall-do as I-have-done: the-upper-lip you-shall-not-cover, and-the-bread-of men you-shall-not-eat. |
| LOGOS | And you shall do as I have done. You shall not cover your upper lip, nor eat the bread of men. |
| PNEUMA | When that happens, you must do what Ezekiel has done. Don't cover your faces in mourning. Don't eat the mourners' bread. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 24:16 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Son-of man, behold-Me taking from-you the-desire-of your-eyes with-a-plague; but-you-shall-not-lament, and-you-shall-not-weep, and-your-tears shall-not-come. |
| LOGOS | "Son of man, behold, I am about to take the delight of your eyes away from you at a stroke; yet you shall not mourn or weep, nor shall your tears run down. |
| PNEUMA | "Son of man, I am about to take away the person you love most — with a single blow. But you must not mourn. You must not cry. Don't let a single tear fall. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
